details: An initial combined display included 08.md but was truncated. It did not establish complete reading. The full 08 body was subsequently read in bounded consecutive ranges 1–170,171–305,306–450, followed by complete 09 and 10 in bounded ranges. A later combined license display was also truncated; only the explicit focused license ranges reread at the end are claimed as that source coverage.

curl piped to head returned write error23 when head closed after the requested HTML prefix. This was not treated as a failed site request or site-readiness evidence. The actual browser later loaded the root with HTTP200.

First Chromium rendering attempt failed with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR on a file URL; own Node process was interrupted (exit130). Rendering exact SVG bytes with page.setContent succeeded for all12. The first terminal error is explicitly a transcript, not a raw stderr capture.

First path helper expected a relative href attribute and timed out. The actual site had resolved absolute hrefs; suffix selection followed the existing links successfully. Original script and raw stderr are retained.

Second helper assumed every goto returns an HTTP response; a same-document anchor change returned null. Handling that normal browser case allowed the requested T.4/T.8 inspection. Third attempt persisted each navigation record and completed27 records without page errors. This helper error does not imply a broken book anchor.

Bookkeeping saved the report and completed current-source/artifact assertions, then its summary print indexed a Path and raised TypeError. Final check uses proper path composition. Original terminal error is preserved as a transcript; no book source changed and no judgment was revised.
